facts.fact: The DGI director-general says the telepayment platform, officially launched in December 2021, lets taxpayers of the computerised centres pay taxes, duties and fees electronically by bank transfer only.
The DGI director-general says electronic receipts reached 300 billion FCFA in 2024, 30% of receipts against 2% in 2022 and up 34% on 2023.

systems.platform: interbank bank-transfer exchange with Treasury and DGI
